selection_rule: Fixed state_35 for all tasks. State 35 is in factorized teacher range (35-49) and CS200 clean data (0-49). Goal tasks cover negative controls (t00, t07) and known critical tasks (t01, t06, t08, t09 from K10 audit). Other suites: one known positive + one negative from K10 audit.

episodes.purpose: Goal negative control — K10 audit shows zero cc, zero critical
Goal critical window — K10 audit shows 855 cc steps, 44 critical
Goal feasible — K10 audit shows 2 feasible episodes, 510 critical, 265 starts
Goal negative control — zero cc, zero critical
libero_10 positive control — known critical windows
libero_10 negative — K10 audit: 0 feasible, 22 critical only

pipeline.step2_v22: compute V22 factors (grasp, contact, comotion, lift, instability, terminal)
pipeline.step3_label_v2: V22 factors → Label Contract V2 five-head tri-state labels via evidence lattice
pipeline.step4_k10: recompute K10 from V22 criticality sequence (NOT from old labels)
pipeline.step5_output: atomic JSONL per episode + pilot receipt
pipeline.k10_formula: K10_t = AND_{i=t}^{t+9} (critical_i AND known_i AND NOT safe_release_i)
